messages:
Sam (Partnerships): BridgeWave engineering just ran our staging tests and their adapter fails on our new /v2/responses envelope. They asked for a compatibility bridge and a CI-friendly smoke harness. any quick wins?
Maya (Eng-API): are they on marketplace-v2 or still on the legacy vendor bridge?
Sam (Partnerships): still on marketplace-v1. they said their SDK validates envelope keys and header presence strictly.
Lin (Eng-Platform): we could add a per-partner translation layer at the edge that rewrites /v2 responses to the old envelope shape for requests coming from marketplace-v1. it's similar to our shim for old streaming clients.
Maya (Eng-API): that sounds doable. alternative is a short-lived header compatibility shim: if request includes X-RDW-Compat:bridgewave, return both shapes in the payload (old and new) so their adapter picks older keys. less intrusive to routing rules.
Nora (PM): timeline ask: BridgeWave wants a compat window of 4 weeks and a CI snippet to validate in their nightly runs. They want a firm sunset date included in the comms.
Sam (Partnerships): can we promise a 4-week dual-shape bridge and provide a small Node + Python harness?
Lin (Eng-Platform): yes. i'll add a flagged translation middleware behind feature-flag "bridgewave-compat-bridge" and expose an endpoint /compat/bridgewave/test that returns sample payloads.
Maya (Eng-API): i'll prepare the translation logic. key rules: 1) keep tokenization and streaming semantics identical, 2) preserve both envelope roots: {"response_v2": ..., "response_v1": ...}, 3) add X-RDW-Compat header when translated.
Sam (Partnerships): can we also emit telemetry so we can know how many requests still rely on v1 envelope? need metrics: counts for v1-only, v2-only, and dual responses per partner.
Lin (Eng-Platform): added to the plan. will push counters and a small grafana dashboard tile.
Maya (Eng-API): sample curl for their CI:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
     -H "X-RDW-Compat: bridgewave" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/compat/bridgewave/test \
     -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Nora (PM): comms draft to BridgeWave: "We will enable a compatibility bridge for your marketplace-v1 adapter for a 4-week period starting 2025-11-10. During this time we will emit both v1 and v2 envelope shapes for translated requests. Please run the provided CI snippet and report any failures by 2025-11-17. Our dashboard will show migration progress; we will remove the bridge on 2025-12-08."
Sam (Partnerships): ok i'll send that and include the Node+Python harness. also flag legal/ops.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: feature-flag 'bridgewave-compat-bridge' -> canary at 2025-11-10T04:00Z. CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4789
Maya (Eng-API): once canary is green i'll ship docs and the private gist for the harness.
Lin (Eng-Platform): i'll wire telemetry and the grafana tile; ping me if partner asks for per-region toggles.
Sam (Partnerships): thanks all. next steps: lin/maya implement bridge + telemetry, nora finalize comms, sam sends partner the harness and date. we can close after canary verification. :thumbsup:
